assessments.reasoning: Event bacd88b28f9149d4b41baa81cfb44d72, Mozilla archive, NPL 1.1 governing revision 1, [2634,3046). V.3 itself supplies both the source-code scope and the express different-terms language. The embedded §13 on designated multiple-licensed portions is a separate provision.

challenge.method: Tested an unincorporated contributor change, a downstream licensee, importing V.2’s two-year restriction, and substituting the NPL 1.0 wording.
challenge.results: V.3 specifies incorporated Modifications and Netscape as actor. V.2’s clock belongs to its other-products provision. The 1.1 different-terms phrase expressly repeats Branded Code, resolving the object that is unclear in 1.0.

limitations: Amendment II defines Branded Code by Netscape’s distribution or authorization under Netscape-controlled marks unlicensed under this license. The conclusion is specific to V.3 of the captured NPL 1.1 plaintext.
reasoning: NPL 1.1 V.3 names Netscape as the actor, identifies Source Code of its Branded Code including incorporated Modifications, and expressly permits licensing “such Netscape Branded Code” on different terms.
